entities.title: Only C# is parsed
entities.summary: Every language but C# gets symbols from per-line regexes.
entities.impact: find_symbol and overview can miss or misread declarations outside C# (multi-line signatures, macros, nested items get no container). Languages without rules (JSON, YAML, TOML, SQL, XML, plain text) get no symbols.
entities.workaround: zazzle_outline (tree-sitter for Rust, Python, C, JS/TS) or zazzle_find for what the index misses.

entities.title: No symbols for text over 2 MiB
entities.summary: A text blob larger than 2 MiB gets a line count but no symbols.
entities.impact: Such files do not appear in find_symbol; their digest says "too large for symbols".
